init.title: Streaming TTS Proxy Settings
init.description: Default voice parameters, buffer size, and fallback TTS server configuration.

data_description.sample_rate: Value for the WAV header, typically 22050 Hz. Changing this value alters audio pitch and playback speed.
data_description.buffer_blocks: Sets the number of pre-synthesized paragraphs and the amount of audio sent to the player buffer in advance. Default is 1. Increase this value if you experience pauses during playback.
data_description.fallback_voice: The voice name can be found in Media > Text-to-Speech after adding the server as a standard TTS integration.
data_description.fallback_sample_rate: Similar to the primary server sample rate parameter.
data_description.fallback_supports_streaming: Enable if the fallback server supports native streaming mode.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the TTS server to retrieve settings. Please check the host and port.
